results.title: Viet Film Fest 2026 Announces This Year’s Lineup and Special Events, Tickets Now on Sale - VAALA Presents Viet Film Fest
results.content:
Set in the mid 1980s of post-war Saigon, Ky Nam Inn is Leon Le’s latest romantic drama detailing the nuanced lives of private individuals in the midst of a changing Vietnam. The plot centers on Khang (Liên Bỉnh Phát), a young translator from Da Lat who moves into a working-class neighborhood and meets a cast of animated characters that give the film its livelihood. He falls for a middle-aged widow, Ky Nam (Đỗ Thị Hải Yến), who cooks in the neighborhood.
